item.title: EU sets South Korean steel ‘duty-free quota’ at 2.07 million tons… Halved risk avoided but burden grows (EU, 한국 철강 ‘무관세 쿼터’ 207만톤으로…반토막 피했지만 부담 커져)
item.description:
The European Union (EU) has set the annual volume of duty-free steel imports from South Korea at 2.073 million tons. As the EU’s total duty-free import volume is nearly halved, South Korea’s share avoided being cut in half. However, the volume that South Korean companies can export without competition from other countries has decreased by about 510,000 tons, increasing the burden. (유럽연합(EU)이 한국산 철강에 관세를 매기지 않는 연간 물량을 207만3천톤으로 정했다. 유럽연합 전체 무관세 수입 물량이 절반 가까이 줄어드는 가운데 한국 몫은 ‘반토막’을 피했다. 다만 한국 기업이 다른 나라와 경쟁 없이 수출할 수 있는 물량은 기존보다 약 51만톤 줄어 부담이 커졌다.)

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced that the European Commission unveiled country-specific quotas under a new steel import management system on the 30th. Starting July 1, the EU will reduce the annual duty-free import limit for 30 steel products from the current 33.82 million tons to 18.35 million tons. The tariff rate for volumes exceeding the limit will also rise from the current 25% to 50%. (산업통상부는 유럽연합 집행위원회가 30일 새 철강 수입관리제도의 국가별 쿼터를 발표했다고 밝혔다. 유럽연합은 7월1일부터 철강 30개 품목의 연간 무관세 수입 한도를 기존 3382만톤에서 1835만톤으로 줄인다. 한도를 넘는 물량에 부과하는 관세도 기존 25%에서 50%로 올린다.)

South Korea’s dedicated quota has decreased by 19.7%, from the current 2.581 million tons to 2.073 million tons. If the reduction rate of about 46% applied to the EU’s total duty-free volume had been directly applied, South Korea’s share could have reduced to about 1.4 million tons. The final allocation is about 680,000 tons higher than this. This is why the government evaluates that it has significantly defended the basis for the Korean steel industry’s access to the EU market through these negotiations. (한국 전용쿼터는 기존 258만1천톤에서 207만3천톤으로 19.7% 감소했다. 유럽연합 전체 무관세 물량의 감축률인 약 46%를 그대로 적용했다면 한국 몫은 약 140만톤까지 줄어들 수 있었다. 최종 배정량은 이보다 약 68만톤 많다. 정부가 이번 협상으로 한국 철강업계의 유럽연합 시장 접근 기반을 상당 부분 방어했다고 평가하는 이유다.)

However, since the dedicated quota is confirmed volume that can be used without competing with other countries, the reduction itself is a burden. The volume guaranteed to South Korea has decreased by 508,000 tons compared to before. To export beyond the dedicated quota, companies must secure a common quota that multiple countries use on a first-come, first-served basis. A 50% tariff applies to volumes that fail to utilize this. (다만, 전용쿼터는 다른 나라와 경쟁하지 않고 쓸 수 있는 확정 물량인 만큼 감소 자체가 부담이다. 한국에 보장된 물량은 기존보다 50만8천톤 줄었다. 전용쿼터를 넘겨 수출하려면 여러 국가가 선착순으로 이용하는 공용쿼터를 확보해야 한다. 이를 이용하지 못한 물량에는 50% 관세가 붙는다.)

The common quota that South Korean companies can additionally utilize is 1.475 million tons. The government explained that by combining the dedicated quota and common quota, up to 3.548 million tons can be exported duty-free. However, this is the maximum under the assumption that South Korean companies secure all of the common quota. Actual volume depends on the outcome of competition with other countries. (한국 기업이 추가로 이용할 수 있는 공용쿼터는 147만5천톤이다. 정부는 전용쿼터와 공용쿼터를 더하면 최대 354만8천톤까지 무관세로 수출할 수 있다고 설명했다. 그러나 이는 한국 기업이 공용쿼터를 모두 확보한다는 가정에 따른 최대치다. 실제 물량은 다른 나라와의 경쟁 결과에 따라 달라진다.)

As the EU, following the US, also raises steel import barriers, attention is also focused on the government’s support measures for the industry. An industry insider said, “Companies that focus on Europe as their main market will inevitably face a heavy burden as a 50% tariff applies to volumes outside the duty-free quota,” adding, “Substantial support measures that these companies can actually feel are necessary.” Within the industry, there are also voices calling for export market diversification as well as demands to ease burdens like anti-dumping measures and energy costs such as electricity rates. (미국에 이어 유럽연합도 철강 수입 장벽을 높이면서 정부의 업계 지원책에도 관심이 쏠린다. 철강업계 한 관계자는 “유럽을 주력 시장으로 삼는 기업들은 무관세 쿼터 밖 물량에 50% 관세가 붙어 부담이 클 수밖에 없다”며 “해당 기업이 체감할 수 있는 실질적인 지원책이 필요하다”고 말했다. 업계에서는 수출시장 다변화와 함께 반덤핑 조처, 전기료 등 에너지 비용 부담 완화를 요구하는 목소리도 나온다.)

The government plans to analyze the final quota and allocation results of competitor countries, then formulate support plans for relevant ministries, steel companies, and small and medium-sized enterprises, announcing them soon. It will share the EU’s quota operation method and exhaustion status with the industry and support the discovery of alternative export markets. The government also intends to strengthen trade remedy measures, such as anti-dumping, against unfairly imported steel products. (정부는 최종 쿼터와 경쟁국의 배정 결과를 분석한 뒤 관계부처와 철강기업·중소업체 지원방안을 마련해 조만간 발표할 계획이다. 업계에 유럽연합의 쿼터 운영 방식과 소진 현황을 공유하고, 대체 수출시장 발굴도 지원한다. 불공정 수입 철강재에 대해서는 반덤핑 등 무역구제 조처를 강화할 방침이다.)

Trade Minister Yeo Han-koo stated, “We will cooperate between the government and the industry to maximize the utilization of the common quota, regardless of what operational method the EU adopts,” adding, “We will also continue pursuing free trade agreements to expand steel export markets to the Global South, including Latin America, Central Asia, and Africa.” (여한구 통상교섭본부장은 “유럽연합이 어떤 운영 방식을 만들더라도 공용쿼터를 최대한 활용할 수 있도록 정부와 업계가 협조하겠다”며 “중남미와 중앙아시아, 아프리카 등 글로벌 사우스로 철강 수출시장을 넓히기 위한 자유무역협정 추진도 이어가겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ha-young Yoo yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Business closures among self-employed decrease, but food and retail sectors close over 15% of stores (자영업 폐업 줄었지만…음식·소매업 15% 넘게 문 닫아)
item.description:
Overall closure indicators in South Korea's self-employed sector have improved, but closure rates in neighborhood commerce sectors such as food and retail have risen, deepening polarization. <<> According to the "Closure Statistics Analysis and Survey of Closed Small Business Owners" released by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups on the 30th, the total number of closed businesses last year (based on business registration) was 976,000, a decrease of 32,000 from the previous year. The overall closure rate also fell by 0.4 percentage points to 8.64%. <<> However, narrowing the focus to the six main small business sectors (retail, food, services, accommodation, wholesale, and manufacturing), closures in these industries amounted to 751,000 businesses, accounting for 77% of the total. Their average closure rate stood at 11.08%, indicating that the impact of the economic downturn was concentrated on small self-employed businesses. In particular, the closure rates for retail (15.40%) and food services (15.14%) were high. The survey consisted of "quantitative statistics" analyzing the National Tax Service's data on business closures to measure related scales and "qualitative statistics" based on a survey of 1,500 closed small business owners. <<> According to the qualitative statistics, the main reason for involuntary closures was "deteriorating profitability and poor sales" (70.9%). Among those who experienced poor sales, 62.5% attributed it to "customer decline." In addition, rising costs for raw materials (29.4%), labor (28.8%), and fixed expenses (24.9%) combined to push them to a critical point. In the quantitative statistics, "poor business performance" accounted for 50.4% of closures. <<> The problem is that small business owners suffer from a double burden of massive debt and store closure costs when shutting down their shops. At the time of deciding to close, 68.5% of small business owners had debts. The average debt amount was calculated at 85.31 million won. Additional costs for closure averaged 12.86 million won, with store restoration costs (5.59 million won) accounting for the largest portion. <<> Reporter Lee Joo-bin yes@hani.co.kr (국내 자영업계의 전반적인 폐업 지표가 개선됐지만 음식업과 소매업 등 골목상권 폐업률은 높아지며 양극화가 심화한 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung’s Mega Project: Honam Semiconductor Cluster—Redressing 50 Years of Imbalance? [Expert Report] (‘이재명 메가프로젝트’ 호남 반도체…50년 불균형 바로잡나 [전문가 리포트])
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung officially announced the establishment of a semiconductor production base in the southwestern Honam region during the “Grand Leap Forward: Three Mega Projects National Briefing” held at the Blue House on June 29. According to the plan, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix will invest a combined 800 trillion won to build two memory semiconductor fabs (production lines) each in the newly inaugurated Gwangju-Jeonnam Unified Special City, which launched on July 1. Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won personally took the stage that day to announce their investments in the Gwangju and southwestern region (the Southwestern Semiconductor Cluster). If this plan becomes a reality, President Lee Jae-myung is expected to be recorded as a key figure in industrial policy who opened a new era for South Korea’s manufacturing sector through investment and workforce training on a scale surpassing President Park Chung-hee’s heavy and chemical industrialization drive. <<> Of course, this announcement has sparked widespread criticism that it reignites regionalism. Political circles, in particular, have seen an eruption of arguments about the neglect of the Yeongnam region and demands for regional balance, with backlash saying, “Why Honam?” and “This is favoring Honam.” Seemingly aware of this opposition, the government also unveiled regional balanced development measures at the national briefing. Representative examples include plans to foster the physical AI industry centered on Saemangeum and the Daegu-Gyeongbuk (Yeongnam) region, and to build an AI data center worth 1,000 trillion won in the Chungcheong and Gangwon regions by 2035. <<> In fact, the expansion of the semiconductor cluster was anticipated. As Chairman Chey Tae-won explained, artificial intelligence is evolving from being centered on large language models (LLMs) toward physical AI or agent-type AI that performs actual tasks, leading to a surge in demand for data, memory, and sensors. The trend where governments and big tech companies from around the world sent love calls to NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang to secure supplies of graphics processing units (GPUs)—the core chips for AI—has now shifted to an era where Jensen Huang invites Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix executives for “chimaek” (chicken and beer). Memory semiconductors are already fully booked for years, and if hyper-scaler (large tech companies providing cloud computing and data management services, like NVIDIA and Google) investments continue at the current pace, fab expansion is inevitable. <<> What distinguishes the current discussions about the Southwestern Semiconductor Cluster from past ones is that the entire semiconductor production process will be located in the Honam region. Previously, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix had considered building back-end (packaging) semiconductor manufacturing plants in Honam, but they shifted direction to include not just back-end processes but also the front-end fabs (production lines). <<> A key problem in South Korea’s manufacturing sector is the regional disparity created by spatial division of labor. Conceptual functions such as R&D, design, and planning are concentrated in the Seoul metropolitan area—including Seoul, Pangyo, Suwon, and Yongin—while non-metropolitan regions are tasked solely with execution functions like final assembly and supply of equipment and parts. About 77% of the top 500 companies by sales have their headquarters in the capital area, while fewer than 3% are headquartered in Gwangju, South Jeolla, or North Jeolla. The core issue is that non-metropolitan regions, which supply only production-line and some managerial workers, fail to provide sufficient jobs for young people. For every 10,000 young people, there are 282 job postings in the capital area, compared to just 69 in South Jeolla—the lowest nationwide. Even Ulsan, which dubbed itself an “industrial capital” after the 1973 heavy and chemical industrialization drive, and the heavy chemical industries in the southeastern coastal industrial complexes have in the last decade sent their R&D and engineering centers to Seoul and Pangyo, while relying on automation and subcontracting at local plants, hiring few regular workers. <<> However, semiconductor fabs are highly reliant on engineering talent. According to expert estimates, one fab requires about 8,000 engineering personnel, of whom nearly 6,000 are engineers and researchers with at least a bachelor’s degree. With four fabs, that translates to a demand for at least 10,000 to 20,000 college-graduate workers. Since the conceptual and execution functions are not separated but are concentrated together in the cluster, the semiconductor industry is a game-changer, unlike heavy industries where R&D and production bases are split. Assuming operations begin in the mid-2030s, the required workforce must be filled by hiring at least 1,000 to 2,000 or more people annually over the next decade. For companies, this amounts to a life-or-death talent war. Even in peak hiring years, the shipbuilding industry struggled to fill 1,000 positions across three companies (HD Hyundai Heavy Industries, Hanwha Ocean, and Samsung Heavy Industries) combined. In contrast, as Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom noted, the semiconductor industry presents “unfamiliar numbers” even in terms of employment. <<> Even setting aside the question of whether young people from Seoul will move to the provinces, it is clear that local universities such as Chonnam National University, Jeonbuk National University, Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST), and Korea University of Technology (KoreaTech) in the Honam region must maximize their semiconductor engineering departments and engineering school capacities. <<> Until now, the refrain has been that talented local STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) graduates—who want to stay—leave because there are no jobs in their regions. The semiconductor “top two” firms’ cluster in the Southwestern region will become a job provider on an entirely different scale. How to supply global top-tier talent will become an urgent issue for the local labor market. <<> From the logic of region-led growth and balanced development, two critical issues emerge. First, can Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix break the path of South Korea’s uneven development that has accumulated since the 1970s? The early economic development plans were thoroughly centered on the Gyeongbu axis, and Honam was excluded from the industrial development axis at least until the 1980s. Its only notable industries were the Yeosu refinery and petrochemical complex—assigned for political purposes in response to the “Honam neglect” discourse that emerged around the opposition party in the 1970s—and the Gwangyang Steelworks, a satellite of POSCO. With weak manufacturing, distribution and construction flourished locally, and civil society’s criticism of Honam’s “talkative and contentious” civil engineering and construction industries ultimately stems from the underdevelopment of mainstream manufacturing. <<> Second, can the industrial policies of the Lee Jae-myung administration—represented by the semiconductor cluster, the National AI Data Center, Hyundai Motor Group’s Saemangeum robot, AI, and hydrogen hub, and the renewable energy cluster—succeed in creating a new model for region-led growth, building on Honam’s past industrial policy failures? Honam has pursued numerous industrial policies, much like Daegu, which after its textile industry rolled out “Mobile City,” “Medi City,” and “Water Industry City” and more recently focused on fostering the robotics industry, yet none became a new regional growth engine. Consider Gunsan, North Jeolla. The factory established by Daewoo Motors in 1996 (GM Gunsan Plant) closed in 2018 and was sold to the Myeongshin consortium in 2019. Hyundai Heavy Industries’ Gunsan Shipyard, completed in 2010 at a cost of 1.2 trillion won, suspended operations in 2017 and was sold to J-Ocean Heavy Industries in June of this year for 780 billion won. When the GM plant closed, about 10,000 workers, including those at partner companies, lost their jobs. The suspension of the Gunsan Shipyard led to the closure of about 60 partner companies, and nearly 5,000 people left Gunsan. <<> When both plants shut down together, 70,000 people—about one-sixth of Gunsan’s population—faced a threat to their livelihoods. Hundreds of billions of won in local government subsidies, along with access roads and workforce training support, proved powerless against the parent company’s withdrawal or relocation decisions made on “economic logic.” The local anger—“attract a company only to have it take the money and run”—thus repeated itself every time. North Jeolla spent over 30 years deliberating how to use Saemangeum but found no answer until Hyundai Motor Group’s 9 trillion won investment in February this year. Gwangju, throughout the Moon Jae-in administration, sought a “Gwangju-type win-win job model” through Hyundai Motor’s subsidiary Gwangju Global Motors (GGM), but even under the principle of compensating low wages with welfare benefits, the housing and welfare support promised by Gwangju was slowly fulfilled. The legitimate labor rights of union formation and collective bargaining directly clashed with the model’s premise of a “no-union, fair-wage” approach. Amid that conflict, the win-win job model failed to fully prove its value as an alternative. <<> Each case has its own unique reasons for failure, but overall, the biggest factor is that, from the perspective of spatial division of labor, they clung to attracting “branch plants” where the headquarters and production factories were separated. In GM’s case, R&D was handled by the Bupyeong headquarters and global production bases, while the GM Gunsan plant was a production base that received “work orders.” The Gunsan Shipyard similarly served as a recipient of surplus “work orders” from the Ulsan headquarters during boom times. Even the vehicle model brought in by Gwangju Global Motors was not Hyundai’s flagship Genesis or Grandeur, but the minor lineup Casper. Although it stabilized with annual production exceeding 200,000 units and 90% exports, its capacity to increase output by shifting to two shifts depended on headquarters’ decisions, keeping production at around 50,000 units annually and revealing its limitations. In other words, these factories were not independent industrial hubs but remained branch plants of headquarters, making them vulnerable to changes in the economic and business environment. <<> Earlier, in an October 2023 “Expert Report” (Ecological Crisis Amid Semiconductor Hegemony Competition), I proposed the Daegu-Gyeongbuk (TK) and Chungcheong regions as alternatives in case the Yongin semiconductor cluster faced water and power limits. This was due to the advantages of existing power infrastructure and water systems. Considering the national capabilities required to install high-voltage transmission lines and secure water supply for the Yongin fabs—ground has not yet been broken—it cannot be deemed unreasonable to invest in Honam, which has been excluded from the development axis for 50 years, and to seek solutions through technology and governance. Nevertheless, the completion and operation of the Honam semiconductor cluster is a much more distant prospect. There are bound to be twists and turns ahead. Since semiconductor demand can fluctuate at any time, the risk of investment momentum faltering over the long period between groundbreaking and completion remains constant. <<> Ultimately, there are two ways to reduce the risk. One is sustained investment in local talent. More than 10,000 STEM professionals needed by the fabs should be cultivated in partnership with local universities, and settlement conditions must be created to ensure they stay in the region. If this is supported by education, research, and opportunities for startups and businesses in semiconductors and AI, the cluster can naturally become vibrant. The other is to establish robust governance to carry the project from groundbreaking through to operation. The successful completion and stable operation of the fabs, as well as Honam’s goals for energy transition and fostering the physical AI industry, ultimately depend on collaboration among the government, local authorities, companies, and universities. Interests must be coordinated, and transparent decision-making structures put in place. Apart from the Park Chung-hee administration’s developmental state projects, it is difficult to find successful cases of regional industrial policy. This time, Honam must create a new model. The time calls for proceeding just as cautiously as the high expectations. <<> Yang Seung-hoon, Professor at Kyungnam University (Sociology) (이재명 대통령은 6월29일 청와대에서 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회’를 열어 서남권(호남) 반도체 생산기지 조성을 공식화했다. 1일 출범하는 전남광주통합특별시에 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스가 총 800조원을 들여 각각 메모리 반도체 팹(생산라인) 2기씩을 구축한다는 것이다. 이재용 삼성전자 회장과 최태원 에스케이그룹 회장이 이날 직접 단상에 올라 광주·서남권 투자(서남권 반도체 클러스터)를 밝혔다. 이런 계획이 현실로 이어진다면 이재명 대통령은 박정희 대통령의 중화학공업화를 뛰어넘는 규모의 투자와 인력 양성 등을 통해 대한민국 제조업의 새로운 시대를 연 산업정책의 주역으로 기록될 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: “Got concessions for Yongin; could delay investment if the cycle turns”… Honam semiconductor ‘ambiguity’ remains a challenge (“용인 챙겼으니, 업황 꺾이면 투자 미룰 수도”…호남 반도체 ‘모호성’ 숙제)
item.description:
(☞Subscribe to the Hankyoreh newsletter H:730. Search for ‘Hankyoreh h730’ in the search bar.) ((☞한겨레 뉴스레터 H:730 구독하기. 검색창에 ‘한겨레 h730’을 쳐보세요.))

Evaluations suggest that fleshing out the plans for the government’s ‘three mega-projects,’ centered on building the ‘southwestern semiconductor cluster,’ will be a key factor determining future success or failure. This is because core details such as investment location and timing have not been presented, and the investment scale mixes existing plans with new ones, making it difficult to take the figures at face value. Some opinions call for conditional mechanisms that specify corporate ‘verbal promises’ and adjust government support if they are not fulfilled. <<> President Lee Jae-myung held a ‘Public Report on the Vision for Advanced Industry Development in the Southwestern Region’ at the Kim Dae-jung Convention Center in Gwangju on the 30th, discussing investment plans for the southwestern region with business leaders. It is a follow-up to the ‘Public Report on the Three Mega-Projects for Korea’s Great Leap’ held the previous day at the presidential office, presided over by President Lee. Samsung Electronics Vice Chairman Jeon Young-hyun and SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung announced their respective companies’ investment plans for the southwestern semiconductor sector at the event and signed investment MOUs with government ministries. However, even at this event, the location of the southwestern semiconductor cluster and the investment timeline—key details—were not mentioned, following the pattern of the previous day. <<> Despite signing investment MOUs, the core missing details seem to stem from the strategic calculations of the two companies. The logic appears to be: ‘Since we secured solid benefits in Yongin, there’s no reason to immediately embrace Honam’s uncertainties.’ The previous day, the government promised full support for the Yongin semiconductor specialized complex—where large-scale semiconductor production facilities are already under construction—including regulatory simplification and undergrounding of power grids, to shorten the construction timeline by up to 12 years. <<> From the companies’ perspective, they have a sure card in Yongin. In contrast, unlike the government’s expectation that the semiconductor super-cycle will last longer than in the past, anxiety that a decline in global demand and the resolution of supply shortages could come sooner is cited as a factor making companies hesitant to invest in Honam. <<> A large corporation official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said, “It seems companies have gained the sure benefit of support for the Yongin semiconductor cluster while making the uncertain promise of investment in Gwangju and Honam.” “There will likely be escape routes, such as delaying Honam investment plans if the semiconductor cycle turns down.” <<> Amid companies not presenting specific business plans, the government appears to be accelerating. President Lee made clear his commitment to completing the projects within his term at the public report, stating, “We will set up a dedicated team at the presidential office to responsibly support the entire process so that there is no delay—even of a single month—after the plans are announced.” This is interpreted as a move to block companies from delaying or reducing investments in the future. <<> The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy also announced that it would complete the infrastructure construction for the Honam semiconductor cluster within five years. However, the previous day, the presidential office stated it would accelerate the development of the industrial complex with the goal of starting construction of semiconductor fabs within the current administration’s term, which is actually a tight schedule just for setting up the infrastructure. <<> The scale of investment itself is also controversial. The previous day, the government announced a total investment of 1,461 trillion won for the three mega-projects. These include 800 trillion won for building a semiconductor production base in the southwest, 550 trillion won for establishing an AI data center, 81 trillion won for developing a packaging base in the Chungcheong region, and 30 trillion won for next-generation semiconductor investment. However, the combined investment amount announced by Samsung and SK actually reaches 4,755 trillion won. As existing and new investment plans are mixed together, it is difficult to determine the amount of new investment being made this time. <<> While experts positively evaluate the direction of this announcement, they point out that without concrete implementation plans, it could remain merely a declaration. Lee Jong-hwan, a professor of system semiconductor engineering at Sangmyung University, said, “The government has drawn a big picture and presented a strategic direction for Korea’s semiconductor and AI industry, which seems significant.” “Since the demand for AI semiconductors is fluid, it may not be easy for companies to draw up detailed execution plans, but they should continue to supplement them by providing more detailed content.” <<> Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Nam-il namfic@hani.co.kr (‘서남권 반도체 클러스터’ 구축을 핵심으로 하는 정부의 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’를 두고 계획을 구체화하는 것이 향후 성패를 가를 핵심 과제라는 평가가 나온다. 투자 지역과 시기 등 핵심 내용이 제시되지 않은데다, 투자 규모 역시 기존 투자 계획과 신규 계획이 섞여 있어 규모를 그대로 받아들이기 어렵다는 점에서다. 기업의 ‘구두 약속’을 구체화하고 미이행 땐 정부 지원을 조정하는 조건부 장치가 필요하다는 의견도 제시된다.)

item.title: 'Semiconductor Boom' June Exports Top $100 Billion for First Time... 4th in the World (‘반도체 호황’ 6월 수출액 사상 첫 1천억달러 돌파…세계 4번째)
item.description:
Last month, exports surged over 70% year-on-year, surpassing $100 billion (approximately 155 trillion won) on a monthly basis for the first time ever. This is driven by the boom in memory semiconductor exports. (지난달 수출액이 전년 대비 70% 넘게 급증하며 사상 처음으로 월간 기준 1천억달러(약 155조원)를 돌파했다. 메모리 반도체 수출 호황 영향이다.)

The Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced on the 1st that June exports reached $102.25 billion, up 70.9% compared to the same month last year. This marks the first time monthly exports have exceeded $100 billion. South Korea became the fourth country in the world, after Germany, China, and the US, to achieve monthly exports of over $100 billion. (산업통상부는 6월 수출액이 1022억5천만달러로 지난해 같은 달에 견줘 70.9% 늘었다고 1일 밝혔다. 월 수출액이 1천억달러를 넘어선 것은 이번이 처음이다. 한국은 독일, 중국, 미국에 이어 세계에서 넷째로 월 수출액 1천억달러 이상을 달성했다.)

Exports increased in 18 out of the 20 major export items. Last month, semiconductor exports totaled $44.82 billion, soaring 199.5% year-on-year, leading the overall export growth. This was due to a sharp rise in prices driven by increased memory demand. It was also the first time monthly semiconductor exports exceeded $40 billion. (20대 주력 수출 품목 중 18개 품목의 수출이 증가했다. 지난달 반도체 수출액은 448억2천만달러로 전년 동월 대비 199.5% 불어나며 전체 수출 증가를 이끌었다. 메모리 수요 증가에 따라 가격이 껑충 뛰어오른 영향이다. 월간 반도체 수출액이 400억달러를 웃돈 것도 처음이다.)

Exports of automobiles (5.8%), petroleum products (49.8%), petrochemicals (18.8%), and steel (9.6%) also recorded growth. By region, exports to China grew 92.1%, centered on semiconductors, while exports to the US increased by 78.6%. (자동차(5.8%), 석유제품(49.8%), 석유화학(18.8%), 철강(9.6%) 등도 수출 증가세를 기록했다. 지역별로는 대중국 수출이 반도체를 중심으로 92.1% 늘었고, 대미 수출도 78.6% 증가했다.)

In the first half of this year through June, exports totaled $496.7 billion, up 48.4% from the same period last year, setting a record for the highest first-half performance ever. Accordingly, the possibility of achieving $1 trillion in annual exports this year is being anticipated. (올해 들어 6월까지 상반기 수출액은 4967억달러로 전년 동기 대비 48.4% 늘어나며 상반기 기준 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다. 이에 따라 올해 연간 수출액 1조달러 달성 가능성도 점쳐진다.)

Reporter Park Jong-oh pjo2@hani.co.kr (박종오 기자 pjo2@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kookmin University and Korea Arboreta and Gardens Management Develop Technology to Measure Carbon Storage Using LiDAR without Damaging Trees (국민대-한국수목원정원관리원, 나무 훼손 없이 탄소저장량 측정하는 LiDAR 활용 기술 개발)
item.description:
A research team led by Professor Kang Wan-mo from the Department of Forest Environmental Systems at Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol), along with the Urban Biology Conservation Division of the National Sejong Arboretum under the Korea Arboreta and Gardens Management, has developed a technology that can measure the carbon storage of trees non-destructively using terrestrial LiDAR. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 산림환경시스템학과 강완모 교수 연구팀과 한국수목원정원관리원 국립세종수목원 도시생물보전실이 지상 라이다(LiDAR)를 활용해 수목의 탄소저장량을 비파괴적으로 측정할 수 있는 기술을 개발했다.)

Kookmin University and the National Sejong Arboretum have been conducting joint research since signing a business agreement in September 2024 on "Technology Development for Enhancing Carbon Absorption in Urban Forests." Last year, the research team developed a drone-based LiDAR carbon storage prediction formula targeting trees in living gardens. This year, they advanced the technology to measure carbon storage of trees in residential areas more precisely using terrestrial LiDAR. (국민대와 국립세종수목원은 지난 2024년 9월 ‘도시숲 탄소흡수 증진을 위한 기술개발’ 업무협약을 체결한 이후 공동연구를 이어오고 있다. 연구팀은 지난해 생활정원 수목을 대상으로 드론 LiDAR 기반의 탄소저장량 예측식을 개발한 데 이어, 올해는 지상 LiDAR를 활용해 생활권 수목의 탄소저장량을 더욱 정밀하게 측정할 수 있도록 기술을 고도화했다.)

This study was conducted on four major tree species planted in the National Sejong Arboretum and living gardens: zelkova, metasequoia, pine, and horse chestnut. The research team used terrestrial LiDAR equipment to measure tree height, trunk and branch size, and volume in a non-contact manner. Subsequently, they applied the Quantitative Structure Model (QSM) technique, which reproduces the three-dimensional structure of trees based on point cloud data obtained during the measurement process. Through this, they precisely reconstructed the complex geometric shapes of trunks and branches, non-destructively calculated the volume of individual trees, and derived above-ground biomass and carbon storage with high accuracy. (이번 연구는 국립세종수목원과 생활정원에 식재된 주요 수종인 느티나무, 메타세쿼이아, 소나무, 칠엽수 등 4개 수종을 대상으로 진행됐다. 연구진은 지상 LiDAR 장비를 이용해 나무의 높이와 줄기, 가지의 크기 및 부피를 비접촉 방식으로 측정했다. 이후 측정 과정에서 확보한 점군(Point Cloud) 데이터를 기반으로 수목의 3차원 구조를 재현하는 QSM(Quantitative Structure Model) 기법을 적용했다. 이를 통해 복잡한 줄기와 가지의 기하학적 형태를 정밀하게 구현하고, 개체목 단위의 체적을 비파괴적으로 산정하여 지상부 바이오매스와 탄소저장량을 높은 정확도로 산출했다.)

This technology is significant because it can be applied to living gardens or small urban green spaces with complex spatial structures and diverse tree species. It is expected to play a key role in objectively verifying the carbon absorption effects of residential green spaces such as arboreta, gardens, and urban forests in the future. (이 기술은 공간 구조가 복잡하고 수종이 다양한 생활정원이나 소규모 도시녹지에도 적용할 수 있다는 점에서 의미가 있다. 향후 수목원, 정원, 도시숲 등 생활권 녹지공간의 탄소흡수 효과를 객관적으로 검증하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 할 것으로 기대된다.)

Hwang Se-yeon, a master's student in the Department of Forest Resources at Kookmin University's Graduate School who led the research, stated, "Living gardens have diverse growth environments and management methods, making it difficult to accurately calculate carbon storage using only existing allometric equations developed for forested areas." He added, "This study is significant because it has laid the groundwork for automating the process from tree structure extraction to carbon storage calculation, which can be applied even in urban green spaces with complex spatial structures and diverse tree forms." (연구에 주도적으로 참여한 황세연 학생(국민대 일반대학원 산림자원학과 석사과정)은 “생활정원은 생육환경과 관리방식이 다양해 산림지를 대상으로 개발된 기존 상대생장식만으로는 탄소저장량을 정확히 산정하는 데 한계가 있었다”며 “이번 연구는 공간 구조가 복잡하고 수형 조건이 다양한 도심 녹지에서도 수목 구조 추출부터 탄소저장량 산정까지의 과정을 자동화해 적용할 수 있는 기반을 마련했다는 점에서 의미가 크다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the methodology and results of this study were published in the April 2026 issue of the "Journal of the Korean Society of Cadastre and Land Information." (한편, 이번 연구의 방법론과 결과는 2026년 4월 발간된 ‘한국지적정보학회지’에 게재됐다.)

item.title: Duty-free items under $800 can now be brought in without declaration and exchanged via courier (800달러 이내 면세품, 신고 없이 반입해 택배로 교환 가능해진다)
item.description:
From the 1st, exchanging duty-free goods becomes more convenient. (1일부터 면세품 교환이 보다 간편해진다.)

The Korea Customs Service announced that a revised notice on 'Duty-Free Shop Patent and Operation,' centered on simplifying the exchange process for duty-free goods, will apply to items purchased from the 1st. (관세청은 면세품 교환 절차 간소화를 뼈대로 한 ‘보세판매장 특허 및 운영에 관한 고시’ 개정안을 1일 구매한 면세품부터 적용한다고 밝혔다.)

Previously, to exchange items purchased at a duty-free shop within the country, one had to follow these steps: △ declare accompanied goods upon entry regardless of the purchase amount, △ have the goods detained by customs, △ and pick up the exchanged items at the airport delivery counter on the next departure. As a result, duty-free shoppers with no immediate plans to depart again had to give up on exchanges. (그동안 면세점에서 구매한 물품을 국내에서 교환하기 위해서는 △구매 금액과 관계없이 입국할 때 휴대품 신고 △세관에 물품 유치 △교환된 물품은 다음 출국 시 공항 인도장에서 수령하는 절차를 밟아야 했다. 이 때문에 당분간 재출국 계획이 없는 면세점 이용객은 사실상 교환을 포기해야 했다.)

Going forward, items within the duty-free limit ($800 USD) can be brought into the country without a declaration and then exchanged. Exchanges can be done by visiting a downtown duty-free shop or via courier. However, items exceeding the duty-free limit can only be exchanged domestically if customs duties are paid after declaring accompanied goods upon entry, as is currently the case. (앞으로는 면세범위(미화 800달러) 이내 물품의 경우 휴대품 신고를 하지 않아도 국내로 반입한 뒤 교환할 수 있게 된다. 교환은 시내 면세점 방문 또는 택배로 가능하다. 다만 면세범위를 초과하는 물품은 현행과 같이 입국할 때 휴대품 신고 후 세금을 납부한 경우에만 국내에서 교환할 수 있다.)

Additionally, the Korea Customs Service also decided to allow foreign travelers to receive Korean-made products purchased through online duty-free shops at downtown duty-free stores. This aims to broaden the market for small and medium-sized enterprises by enabling immediate pickup of K-beauty, K-food, and other items at duty-free shops. (이 밖에도 관세청은 외국인 여행자가 온라인 면세점을 통해 구매한 국산품을 시내 면세점에서 인도받는 것도 허용하기로 했다. 케이(K)-뷰티, 케이-식품 등을 면세점에서 바로 수령할 수 있게 해 중소기업의 판로를 넓힌다는 취지다.)

item.title: 150x Leverage on KOSPI Volatility... Overseas 'Gambling Halls' Sprout Like Bamboo After Rain (코스피 변동성에 150배 레버리지…해외 ‘도박장’에서도 우훅죽순)
item.description:
Recently, overseas illegal and legal cryptocurrency exchanges have been launching ultra-high-risk futures derivatives that allow leveraging dozens of times on 'KORU' (Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares), a 3x leveraged exchange-traded fund (ETF) tracking the KOSPI listed on the New York Stock Exchange. This unusual phenomenon has been gaining momentum since late June as the KOSPI's volatility has spiked due to sharp swings in semiconductor stocks like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. These unprecedented leveraged products, tradable without special restrictions, are proliferating like mushrooms in a regulatory vacuum left by financial authorities. <<> According to the global chart analysis platform 'TradingView' website as of the 1st, overseas cryptocurrency exchange KuCoin listed (supported trading for) the 'KORUUSDT.P' derivative—a 'perpetual futures' product allowing up to 20x leverage on 'KORU'—starting June 24th. Perpetual futures are cryptocurrency-focused leveraged derivatives with no expiry date, allowing positions to be held indefinitely, enabling leveraged trading in both bullish and bearish directions without directly holding the underlying asset. KORU (Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares) is a NYSE-listed ETF that triples the daily return of the MSCI Korea Index, which includes Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. <<> This overseas cryptocurrency exchange, KuCoin, is effectively an illegal entity that the Financial Services Commission (FSC) has classified as an unregistered exchange and referred for investigation. On the same day, other major overseas cryptocurrency exchanges such as OKX and Bybit also simultaneously launched products offering 20x leverage on KORU. The product names are mostly displayed as 'KORUUSDT.P.' This means trading KORU futures derivatives using the dollar-based stablecoin Tether (USDT). <<> The rapid spread of these overseas speculative gambling products riding on KOSPI volatility is a recent development. Earlier, on June 2nd, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange Binance fired the starting signal by listing futures offering 20x leverage each on Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Hyundai Motor. Responding to high investor enthusiasm, Binance launched a 'KORU 20x futures' product on June 22nd, and just four days later, added a 50x futures product. Since KORU amplifies daily returns by 3x, this created an unprecedented product allowing up to 150x leverage on KOSPI fluctuations. <<> Following this, on June 22nd, other overseas cryptocurrency exchanges like Bitget, MEXC, XT, and BitMart rushed to list futures derivatives allowing 10x to 20x leverage on KORU. The Financial Services Commission stated, "MEXC, XT, and BitMart, like KuCoin, are unregistered exchanges that the FSC has referred for investigation," adding, "They are essentially just gambling halls set up abroad." <<> Despite being such risky, dollar-investment-based gambling derivatives, there are no specific investment restrictions for domestic residents. Individuals with KRW deposit/withdrawal accounts can purchase Tether (USDT) with won on domestic cryptocurrency exchanges like Upbit or Bithumb, transfer it to overseas exchanges, and trade immediately. These high-risk products, unimaginable in the domestic stock market, are attracting investments worth trillions of won, and some domestic investors are reportedly trading large sums. According to TradingView, Binance's KORU futures trading volume reached $1.35531 billion (approximately 2.1057 trillion won) from June 22nd to the 29th. <<> In reality, however, the financial authorities have essentially washed their hands, citing a lack of regulatory authority. An industry insider commented, "While spot and futures can be appropriately used for hedging, buying and selling leveraged futures in pursuit of a quick fortune is not investing—it's gambling." <<> Jo Gye-wan, Senior Reporter kyewan@hani.co.kr (최근 해외의 불법·합법 가상자산 거래소에서 뉴욕 증시에 상장된 코스피 3배 레버리지 상장지수펀드(ETF) ‘KORU’(Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares)에 수십 배 이상 레버리지를 걸 수 있는 초고위험 선물 파생상품이 잇따라 출시되고 있다. 삼성전자, 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등 반도체 주가 급등락으로 코스피 변동성이 유독 높아지면서 6월 하순부터 본격적으로 나타난 기현상이다. 특별한 제한 없이 거래할 수 있는 초유의 레버리지 상품이 금융당국의 규제 공백 속에 우후죽순 확산하는 양상이다.)

item.title: Google App Market Accused of 'Bullying' Game Companies… Probe into Possible Maximum Fine of 800 Billion Won Initiated (‘게임사들에 갑질’ 구글 앱마켓…과징금 최대 8천억 심의 착수)
item.description:
The Fair Trade Commission has begun deliberations on whether to impose a fine worth hundreds of billions of won on Google, which is suspected of abusing its market-dominant position. Google has been found to have entered into contracts with game companies, setting conditions such as game release dates to be more favorable or at least equivalent on its own app market compared to other Android app markets. (공정거래위원회가 시장지배적 지위를 남용한 혐의를 받는 구글에 수천억원 규모의 과징금을 부과할지 심의에 착수했다. 구글은 게임사들과 계약을 맺어 다른 안드로이드 앱마켓보다 자사 앱마켓에 게임 출시 일자 등 조건을 유리하거나 동등하게 설정하도록 한 것으로 나타났다.)

On the 1st, the FTC's Secretariat submitted a review report detailing sanctions for alleged violations of the Fair Trade Act by Google LLC, Google Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd., and Google Korea LLC to the commission and sent it to Google, initiating the deliberation process. (공정위 사무처는 1일 구글 엘엘씨, 구글 아시아 퍼시픽 피티이 엘티디, 구글코리아 유한회사의 공정거래법 위반 혐의에 대해 제재 의견을 기재한 심사보고서를 위원회에 제출하고 구글에 송부해 심의 절차가 개시됐다고 밝혔다.)

According to the FTC investigation, when game companies attempted to leave the Google app market due to high in-app payment fees, Google signed a contract called the 'GVP' (Games/Google Velocity Program) with major domestic and international game companies from July 2019 to March 2024 to prevent this. The contract targets included top-earning game companies on the Google app market, such as Activision Blizzard King, Riot Games, NCsoft, and Netmarble. (공정위 조사 결과, 구글은 게임사들이 높은 인앱결제 수수료로 구글 앱마켓 이탈을 시도하자 이를 막기 위해 국내외 주요 게임사와 2019년 7월부터 올해 3월까지 ‘지브이피’(GVP·Games/Google Velocity Program) 계약을 체결했다. 계약 대상은 액티비전 블리자드 킹, 라이엇 게임즈, 엔씨소프트, 넷마블 등 구글 앱마켓 매출 상위 게임사들이었다.)

The main content of the contract was to support the costs of using Google platform services like Google Cloud, Google Ads, and YouTube, under the condition that game companies set game release timing, quality, etc., to be more favorable or at least equivalent (most favored treatment) compared to other app markets. In particular, it was investigated that the support amount from Google increased progressively as the Google app market revenue grew. (계약의 주요 내용은 게임사가 게임 출시 시기, 품질 등을 다른 앱마켓보다 유리하게 또는 최소한 동등하게 설정(최혜대우)하는 조건으로 구글클라우드, 구글애즈, 유튜브 등 구글 플랫폼 서비스 이용 비용 등을 지원하는 것이다. 특히 구글 앱마켓 매출액이 증가하면 구글의 지원 금액도 증가하는 누진적 구조였던 것으로 조사됐다.)

The FTC investigator determined that Google, through the contract's most-favored-treatment conditions and progressive support method, significantly hindered game companies' incentives to enter competing app markets, thereby disrupting the business activities of competing app markets like One Store. Additionally, it was judged that the contract effectively forced game companies into exclusive dealings with Google. (공정위 심사관은 구글이 계약의 최혜대우 조건과 누진적 지원 방식 등을 통해 게임사의 경쟁 앱마켓 입점 유인을 현저히 저해함으로써 원스토어 등 경쟁 앱마켓의 사업활동을 방해했다고 판단했다. 또 계약을 통해 게임사에 사실상 구글과의 독점적 거래를 강제했다고 판단했다.)

The FTC calculated that the affected related revenue from the abuse of market-dominant position in the Android app market reached approximately $9.21777 billion (about 14.16 trillion won). Considering the upper limit of fines (for abuse of market-dominant position: 6%), a maximum fine of 849.6 billion won could be imposed. (공정위는 안드로이드 앱마켓 시장에서의 시장지배적 지위 남용행위로 영향을 받은 관련 매출액이 92억1777만달러(약 14조1600억원)에 이르는 것으로 산정했다. 과징금 상한(시장지배적 지위 남용행위·6%)을 고려하면 최대 8496억원의 과징금이 부과될 수 있다.)

The final decision on sanctions and their level will be made by holding a plenary session after receiving opinions from the companies. The companies must submit their opinions within 8 weeks from the date of receiving the review report. (최종 제재 여부와 수준은 업체들의 의견서를 받은 뒤 전원회의를 열어 결정하게 된다. 업체들은 심사보고서 수령일로부터 8주 내 의견을 제출해야 한다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-joo (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Let's create a corporation that pursues public interest"... Could it be a breakthrough for the social solidarity economy? (“공익 추구하는 주식회사 만들자”...사회연대경제 돌파구 될까)
item.description:
Can a 'third type of company' be created, one that is neither a for-profit corporation nor a non-profit legal entity? A proposal has emerged to introduce a new legal personality called a 'public interest corporation' — an entity that explicitly states public interest in its articles of incorporation, generates profits through for-profit activities, and even distributes some of those profits as dividends. This was discussed at the 'National Assembly Forum on the Establishment and Operation of Public Interest Corporations as New Entities for the Social Solidarity Economy,' co-hosted by Rep. Cha Gyu-geun of the Fatherland Innovation Party and the Dongcheon Foundation (Chairman: Yoo Wook) at the National Assembly Members' Office Building in Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul, on the 30th. <<> Areas such as caregiving, community regeneration, and social housing—where the government alone struggles to manage and thus requires private sector involvement—are expanding. Private organizations entering these fields need to generate revenue to sustain their operations (unless based on charity) while also upholding public interest goals. The problem is that there is no suitable legal personality that can encompass both profit and public interest. Non-profit organizations face difficulties in flexible management and capital procurement, while ordinary companies lack mechanisms to ensure they remain committed to public interest. The public interest corporation has been proposed as a new organizational form to fill the gap left by for-profit and non-profit entities. <<> A public interest corporation is essentially a 'stock company aimed at public interest.' According to the draft bill, it would be based on the stock company under the Commercial Act, but with the requirement that at least 60% of its total business be devoted to public interest purposes. Dividends would be limited to one-third of distributable profits, and upon dissolution, remaining assets would not go to shareholders but would be allocated to other public interest organizations. Establishment would require approval from the Minister of Economy and Finance. <<> Lawyer Kim Kyung-mok (of law firm Bae, Kim & Lee), who presented the topic, analyzed models such as the UK's Community Interest Company (CIC), the US's Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), and Austria's limited-profit housing providers, and proposed a model that "compromises between the UK's guarantees of public interest and the US's capital-friendly nature." Co-presenter Lawyer Lee Hee-sook (Dongcheon Foundation) explained the intent of the bill, stating that the public interest corporation "expands the options for choosing a legal personality that aligns with one's business and purpose." <<> One basis for conceptualizing the public interest corporation is the UK's Community Interest Company (CIC), of which over 37,000 have been established since its legal introduction in 2005. This is about 10 times the number of certified social enterprises in South Korea, which introduced a similar system (in 2007) but has fewer than 4,000. Professor Kim Hye-won of Korea National University of Education commented, "In the UK, numerous CICs are created and dissolved each year, actively operating like for-profit businesses. This can be seen as a success from a business perspective." <<> The forum also discussed whether public interest corporations could serve as a breakthrough for the social solidarity economy. Professor Kim Jong-geol of Hanyang University, who moderated the session, pointed out, "Regulations that support public interest activities and supply the necessary funds are scattered across various laws, making it difficult to amend them one by one." Examples include the Civil Act, where administrative agencies have discretion to approve the establishment of non-profit organizations, and the Donation Law, which restricts fundraising. Professor Kim said, "The public interest corporation could be a way to untangle this knot." Professor Kim Hye-won specifically addressed tax issues. She explained, "Currently, even if a public foundation wants to create or invest in a social enterprise subsidiary, high gift taxes block the way. By creating a stable legal personality like the public interest corporation and easing regulations specifically for it, we could open up the flow of blocked public interest funds." <<> Jang Ji-yeon, Secretary-General of the Korea Social Value Solidarity Fund, stated that there is demand in the field for a new legal personality. "There is a strong desire in the field to clearly assert public interest values and gather under that name," said Secretary-General Jang, arguing that a legal personality is needed to encompass this. However, she added that simply creating a legal personality won't make the system work automatically and that supporting measures must accompany it. <<> Government officials who participated as discussants expressed sympathy with the bill's intent but adopted a cautious stance. Lee Jeong-yoon, Director of the Mutual Cooperation Strategy Division at the Ministry of Economy and Finance, said, "Since approval involves administrative costs, we need to consider whether there are ways to improve existing legal personalities and proceed gradually." Jo Chung-rae, Team Leader of the Social Solidarity Economy System Division at the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, which oversees the social solidarity economy, also noted, "We need to examine whether there are any conflicts with the establishment requirements of individual organizations such as cooperatives and social enterprises." Kim Boo-kyung, Director of the Social Enterprise Division at the Ministry of Employment and Labor, which handles social enterprises, expressed concern, saying, "The requirements for social enterprises and the substantive requirements for public interest corporations are almost identical, so the introduction of a new legal personality could render the social enterprise certification system ineffective." <<> Rep. Cha Gyu-geun stated, "Today is not about deciding on the name 'public interest corporation,' but about discussing how to establish appropriate responsibilities and standards. We will reflect the opinions from this forum in the bill review and legislative discussion process." <<> Shin Hyo-jin, Senior Researcher at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute, jinnytree@hani.co.kr (영리회사도 비영리법인도 아닌 ‘제3의 회사’를 만들 수 있을까? 공익을 정관에 명시하고 영리활동으로 이익을 내되 그 일부를 배당까지 하는 새로운 법인격인 ‘공익목적회사’를 도입하자는 제안이 나왔다. 30일 오후 서울 영등포구 국회의원회관에서 차규근 조국혁신당 의원과 재단법인 동천(이사장 유욱)이 공동주최한 ‘사회연대경제 새로운 주체 공익목적회사 설립·운영법안 국회토론회’에서다.)

item.title: Shared Offices Cannot Register as Loan Businesses… ‘Lending in Installments’ Also Blocked (공유오피스 사무실 대부업 등록 못한다…‘쪼개기 대출’도 차단)
item.description:
From now on, requirements for fixed business premises will be tightened when registering as a loan business, and the practice where multiple loan companies evade the submission of income verification documents through installment lending will also be blocked. (앞으로 대부업 등록을 할 때 고정사업장 요건이 강화되고, 여러 대부업체가 쪼개기 대출을 통해 소득증명 서류 제출을 회피하던 편법 영업이 차단된다.)

According to the amendment to the enforcement decree of the ‘Registration of Loan Businesses and Protection of Financial Users Act (Loan Business Act)’ announced for legislative notice on the 1st by the Financial Services Commission, requirements for fixed business premises eligible for loan business registration will be strengthened. Until now, there were many cases where cheap shared offices were rented to easily obtain loan business registration certificates, which were then transferred or sold to illegal private lenders. The Financial Services Commission has decided to reject loan business registrations if shared offices or houses that are not feasible for actual business are registered as offices. Places already used as fixed business premises by other loan companies will also be excluded from registration. <<> ‘Lending in installments,’ where multiple loan companies split loans to avoid the obligation to submit income and debt documents, will also be blocked. The current Loan Business Act exempts loan companies from the obligation to collect income verification documents for small loans of up to 1 million won for youth and the elderly and up to 3 million won for other users. Some loan companies have exploited this by collaborating with other companies to split loan amounts to users, thus evading regulations. <<> From now on, when determining whether exemption from document submission applies, the standards have been revised to include not only existing loan balances and new loan application amounts but also total amounts borrowed from other loan companies within the last 7 days. <<> Jo Kye-wan, Senior Correspondent: kyewan@hani.co.kr (금융위원회가 1일 입법예고한 ‘대부업 등의 등록 및 금융이용자 보호에 관한 법률(대부업법)’ 시행령 개정안에 따르면, 대부업 등록이 가능한 고정 사업장 요건이 강화된다. 그동안 이용료가 저렴한 공유오피스 등을 임차해 대부업 등록증을 손쉽게 발급받은 뒤, 이를 불법사금융업자에게 양도하거나 판매하는 편법 영업이 많았다. 금융위는 실제 영업이 불가능한 공유오피스 및 주택 등을 사무실로 등록한 경우 대부업 등록을 거절하기로 했다. 다른 대부업체가 이미 고정사업장으로 사용 중인 장소도 등록에서 제외한다.)

item.title: Truston Asset Management Calls Taekwang Industrial’s Value Enhancement Plan Inadequate (트러스톤자산 “태광산업의 기업가치 제고 계획 부실”)
item.description:
Truston Asset Management (hereinafter referred to as Truston), the second-largest shareholder of Taekwang Industrial, criticized the company's "2026 Corporate Value Enhancement Plan" announced on the 1st, calling it a deficient report that directly contradicts the intent of the Lee Jae-myung administration's capital market advancement policies. Truston demanded that Taekwang’s board of directors fully reconsider the plan and said it will send an official open letter to shareholders next week to push for its implementation. The Korea Exchange, as part of capital market advancement policies, encourages listed companies to voluntarily disclose their "Corporate Value Enhancement (Value-Up) Plans" and communicate with shareholders. (태광산업의 2대 주주인 트러스톤자산운용(이하 트러스톤)이 1일 태광산업이 공시한 ‘2026년 기업가치 제고 계획’에 대해 이재명 정부의 자본시장 선진화 정책의 취지에 정면으로 역행하는 부실 보고서라고 비판했다. 트러스톤은 태광 이사회에 계획의 전면 재검토를 요구하고, 다음주 중 이를 실행하기 위한 공식 공개 주주서한을 발송할 계획이다, 한국거래소는 자본시장 선진화 정책의 하나로 상장기업이 자발적으로 ‘기업가치 제고(밸류업) 계획’을 공시하고 주주들과 소통하도록 유도하고 있다.)

In its corporate value enhancement plan announced on the 30th, Taekwang Industrial set management goals to increase sales from last year’s 1.8 trillion won to 5 trillion won by 2030 and raise the return on equity (ROE, ratio of net profit to equity) from 2% to 8%. It also stated plans to improve profitability and ROE through expanding high-profit existing businesses and entering new sectors such as beauty, healthcare, and real estate development. However, regarding the demands from Truston and minority shareholders for a 1:50 stock split and an increase in the dividend payout ratio (dividends as a percentage of net profit), which currently stands at a mere 1.77%, the company offered only vague responses such as "active consideration" or "efforts to enhance corporate intrinsic value." Furthermore, regarding the demand to cancel 20% of its 24.4% treasury stock holdings, Taekwang said it would prepare a plan to use them as a resource for strategic mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and seek approval at the 2027 general shareholders' meeting. (태광산업은 지난 30일 발표한 기업가치 제고 계획에서 지난해 1조8천억원이었던 매출액을 2030년에 5조원으로 늘리고, 자기자본이익률(ROE·자기자본 대비 당기순이익 비율)도 2%에서 8%로 높이겠다는 경영목표를 제시했다. 또 고수익 기존사업 확대, 뷰티·헬스케어·부동산 개발 등 신규사업 진출을 통해 수익성 제고와 ROE 개선을 추진하겠다고도 밝혔다. 하지만 트러스톤과 소액주주들이 그동안 요구해온 1대50 비율의 주식 액면분할, 1.77%에 불과한 배당성향(당기순이익 대비 배당금 비율) 상향 조정에 대해서는 ‘적극 검토’나 ‘기업 본질가치 제고 노력’ 같은 형식적 답변에 그쳤다. 또 보유 중인 자기주식 24.4% 가운데 20% 소각 요구에 대해서는 전략적 인수합병(M&A) 재원으로 활용하는 방안을 마련해 2027년 주총에서 승인받겠다고 밝혔다.)

In a press release issued the same day, the activist fund Truston pointed out, "Taekwang’s total dividend payout for the 2025 fiscal year is 1.5 billion won, but excluding the stakes held by the controlling family and related parties, the share returning to ordinary shareholders is only 500 million won (0.05% of market capitalization)." It added, "Taekwang has maintained a shareholder-unfriendly policy with an average dividend payout ratio of 1% over the past decade and freezing the dividend per share for 32 consecutive years." Truston criticized, "Taekwang cites a deteriorating environment, having recorded operating losses for four consecutive years, but the cumulative dividend payout ratio of unlisted affiliates owned by the family of former Chairman Lee Ho-joon, the controlling shareholder, is several to dozens of times higher than that of the listed company." It further argued, "For a high-quality asset company with retained earnings of around 4 trillion won and a debt ratio of 13.5%, about one-ninth the industry average, not to present a single quantitative target, such as dividend payout ratio or total shareholder return (TSR), is a direct distortion of the Value-Up program's intent." (행동주의펀드인 트러스톤은 이날 보도자료를 통해 “태광의 2025년 결산 배당금 총액은 15억 원이지만, 지배주주 일가 및 특수관계인 지분을 제외하면 일반주주에게 돌아가는 몫은 단 5억 원(시가총액의 0.05%)에 불과하다”며 “태광은 10년 평균 배당성향 1%대, 32회 연속 주당 배당금 동결이라는 주주적대적 정책을 고수해 왔다”고 지적했다. 트러스톤은 “태광은 최근 4년 연속 영업손실을 기록한 환경을 이유로 대지만, 지배주주인 이호준 전 회장 일가 소유의 비상장 계열사들의 누적 배당성향은 상장사의 수 배에서 수십 배에 달한다”며 “이익잉여금이 4조 원대에 달하고, 부채비율이 13.5%로 동종업계 평균의 1/9 수준인 자산 우량기업이 배당성향이나 총주주환원율(TSR) 등 단 하나의 정량목표도 제시하지 않은 것은 밸류업 프로그램의 취지를 정면으로 왜곡한 것"이라고 비판했다.)

Truston also noted, "To use treasury shares as a means of exchange for M&A, the stock price must be properly assessed in the market. However, diagnosing a low valuation with a price-to-book ratio (PBR) of 0.22 while planning to use treasury shares as M&A capital is essentially the same as selling them off at a bargain price." (트러스톤은 또 “자사주를 M&A의 교환 수단으로 쓰려면 시장에서 주가가 제대로 평가받아야 하는데, 스스로 주가순자산비율(PBR) 0.22배의 저평가를 진단하면서 자사주를 인수합병 재원으로 활용하겠다는 것은 헐값에 넘기겠다는 의미와 다름없다”고 지적했다.)

Truston demanded that Taekwang Industrial’s board of directors immediately review the corporate value enhancement plan, including presenting clear quantitative targets such as the dividend payout ratio and codifying a principle of phased treasury stock cancellations. It also urged the four independent directors on the board, saying, "Do not formally rubber-stamp the board's deliberation and resolution recommendations as outlined in government guidelines like a show of hands. Instead, in line with the intent of the revised Commercial Act, fulfill your 'duty of loyalty to all shareholders' and directly correct the flaws in this plan." (트러스톤은 태광산업 이사회에 기업가지 제고 계획에 대해 즉각 재검토해 배당성향 등을 포함한 명확한 정량적 목표 제시, 자기주식의 단계적 소각 원칙 명문화 등을 반영할 것을 요구했다. 또 이사회 내 4명의 독립이사를 향해 "정부 가이드라인이 명시한 이사회의 심의·의결 권고를 형식적으로 거수기처럼 추인하지 말고, 상법 개정 취지에 따라 '모든 주주에 대한 충실의무'를 다해 이번 계획의 결함을 직접 시정해야 한다"고 촉구했다.)

Kwak Jeong-su, Senior Correspondent at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute, jskwak@hani.co.kr (곽정수 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임기자 jskwak@hani.co.kr)

item.title: SK to Establish 2 Trillion Won Renewable Energy Company with Private Equity Firm KKR (SK, 사모펀드 KKR와 2조 규모 신재생에너지 기업 설립)
item.description:
SK Inc., the holding company of SK Group, has partnered with Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. (KKR), the world's largest private equity firm, to establish the nation's largest renewable energy company with an enterprise value of 2 trillion won. (에스케이(SK)그룹 지주회사인 에스케이㈜가 세계 최대 사모펀드그룹 콜버그크래비스로버츠(KKR)와 손잡고 기업가치 2조원 규모의 국내 최대 신재생에너지 기업을 설립한다.)

SK Inc. announced on the 1st that it has signed an investment agreement for equity in an integrated renewable energy entity with a fund managed by KKR. Currently, SK Group is in the process of selling the renewable energy business assets of its three affiliates—SK Innovation, SK Ecoplant, and SK Discovery—to KKR. Under the structure, KKR will hold a 51% stake in the integrated entity that consolidates the renewable energy businesses of these three companies, while SK Inc. will invest approximately 1 trillion won (estimated) to secure a 49% stake. The integrated entity (tentatively named HoldCo), valued at 2 trillion won, is expected to officially launch by the end of this year. (에스케이㈜는 케이케이알이 운용하는 펀드와 신재생에너지 통합 법인 지분 투자 계약을 맺었다고 1일 밝혔다. 현재 에스케이그룹은 그룹 산하의 에스케이이노베이션, 에스케이에코플랜트, 에스케이디스커버리 등 3사의 신재생에너지 사업 자산을 케이케이알에 매각하는 절차를 진행 중이다. 케이케이알이 이 3사의 신재생에너지 사업을 모은 통합 법인 지분 51%를 갖고, 여기에 에스케이㈜도 1조원 남짓(추정)을 투자해 지분 49%를 확보하는 구조다. 기업가치 2조원 규모의 통합 법인(가칭 HoldCo)은 올해 말 공식 출범할 예정이다.)

This strategy involves transferring the initial management control of the group's renewable energy business to KKR, allowing SK Group to raise substantial new investment funds without financial burden and to actively leverage KKR's extensive experience in renewable energy investments for business expansion. An SK Inc. official explained, "We have left open the possibility of regaining management control through future negotiations." (이는 케이케이알에 그룹 신재생에너지 사업의 초기 경영권을 넘겨주는 방식을 통해 그룹의 재무 부담 없이 대규모 신규 투자금을 조달하고, 신재생에너지 투자 경험이 많은 케이케이알의 전문성을 사업 확장에 적극 활용하겠다는 전략이다. 에스케이㈜ 쪽은 “추후 협상을 통해 경영권을 다시 확보할 가능성도 열어뒀다”고 설명했다.)

The integrated entity plans to expand its current power capacity of approximately 1.7 gigawatts (GW), from sources such as solar and wind, to 10 GW by 2031. A capacity of 10 GW is sufficient to simultaneously and continuously operate 100 large-scale data centers of 100 megawatts (MW) each. The company expects the integrated entity to grow into a key power source supplying large-scale clean electricity to the current government's "three major mega projects," including semiconductors, artificial intelligence data centers, and physical AI, as well as global semiconductor production lines. (통합 법인은 현재 운용 중인 태양광·풍력 등의 전력 용량 약 1.7기가와트(GW)를 오는 2031년까지 10기가와트로 확대할 계획이다. 10기가와트 용량은 100메가와트(MW)급 대형 데이터센터 100개를 동시에 중단 없이 가동할 수 있는 규모다. 회사 쪽은 통합 법인이 반도체·인공지능 데이터센터·피지컬 인공지능 등 현 정부의 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’를 비롯해 글로벌 반도체 생산 라인 등에 대규모 청정 전력을 공급하는 핵심 전력원으로 성장할 것으로 기대했다.)

item.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Surpasses 1,550 Won Mark… Stays Above 1,500 for 32 Consecutive Trading Days (원-달러 환율 1550원선도 넘어…32거래일째 1500원대)
item.description:
The won-dollar exchange rate continues its upward trend, setting new records daily, driven by a strong US dollar and foreign investors' selling of domestic stocks. (미 달러화 강세와 외국인의 국내 주식 매도세로 원-달러 환율이 상승세를 이어가며 연일 새로운 기록을 써내고 있다.)

On the 1st, in the Seoul foreign exchange market, the won-dollar exchange rate (daytime trading closing price) finished at 1,554.9 won, up 5.5 won from the previous day. This is the highest level since March 5, 2009 (1,568.0 won), during the global financial crisis. It has remained above the 1,500 won mark for 32 consecutive trading days since May 15, and the closing price on this day moved to the upper 1,500 won range, marking a further increase. (1일 서울 외환시장에서 미 달러화에 대한 원화 환율(주간거래 종가)은 전날보다 5.5원 오른 1554.9원에 거래를 마쳤다. 글로벌 금융위기 당시인 2009년 3월5일(1568.0원) 이후 최고 수준이다. 지난 5월15일 이후 32거래일째 1500원대 기록이며, 이날 종가는 1500원대 후반으로 한 단계 더 높아졌다.)

The strengthening of the dollar is fueled by concerns over the US Federal Reserve's potential interest rate hikes, while the yen's weakness is putting upward pressure on the won-dollar exchange rate. The dollar index, which measures the dollar's value against six major currencies, remains in the 101 range. The Japanese yen is also weakening, with the yen-dollar exchange rate surging to the 162 yen level, the highest since December 1986 (158–163 yen) immediately after the Plaza Accord. (미국 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)의 기준금리 인상 경계감으로 달러화 강세 분위기가 형성돼 있는데다 엔화 약세에 연동된 원-달러 환율이 상승 압력을 받고 있다. 주요 6개국 통화 대비 달러 가치를 뜻하는 달러인덱스는 101대를 유지하고 있다. 일본 엔화도 약세를 보여 엔-달러 환율은 플라자 합의 직후인 1986년 12월(158∼163엔) 이후 최고 수준인 162엔대로 치솟아 있다.)

The selling of domestic stocks by foreign investors, considered a key factor in the won's weakness, continued on this day. Foreign investors recorded a net sell-off of 1.7 trillion won in the KOSPI market on a single day. Financial markets anticipate that the outflow of foreign funds, interpreted as portfolio rebalancing following a rise in domestic stock prices, will persist for some time. This is because the stock prices of major large-cap stocks held by foreign investors have risen significantly. (원화 약세의 주요인으로 꼽히는 외국인 투자자들의 국내 주식 매도세는 이날도 이어졌다. 유가증권 시장에서 외국인은 이날 하루 1조7천억원 순매도를 기록했다. 국내 주가 상승에 따른 자산구성 재조정(포트폴리오 리밸런싱)으로 풀이되는 외국인 자금 이탈은 앞으로도 한동안 계속될 것으로 금융시장에선 내다보고 있다. 외국인 보유 대형주의 주가가 대폭 올랐기 때문이다.)

Despite strong semiconductor exports and a record-high current account surplus, the increase in overseas investment by the private sector is constraining the supply of dollars in the domestic foreign exchange market, contributing to the won's weakness. Additionally, the planned large-scale investments in the US under the Korea-US tariff negotiations are cited as a potential destabilizing factor for the foreign exchange market. (반도체 수출 호조와 역대 최대 수준의 경상수지 흑자에도 민간 부문의 해외 투자가 늘어나는 추세에 따라 국내 외환시장에 대한 달러 공급이 제약되고 있는 것 또한 원화 약세 요인으로 꼽힌다. 한-미 관세협상에 따라 미국에 대한 대규모 투자가 예정돼 있다는 사정도 외환시장 안정을 해치는 잠재적인 불안 요소로 거론되고 있다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Staff Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Trump Lifts AI Export Controls on Anthropic but Strengthens Pre-Approval Reviews (트럼프, 앤트로픽 AI 수출통제 풀었지만 ‘사전 심사’는 강화한다)
item.description:
The Trump administration in the United States has agreed to fully lift export restrictions on Anthropic's cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) models, "Mythos 5" and "Fable 5." This comes just 18 days after the administration announced export controls that had shaken the global AI industry last month. (미국 도널드 트럼프 행정부가 앤트로픽과 최첨단 인공지능(AI) ‘미토스5’ 및 ‘페이블5’의 수출 제한을 전면 해제하기로 합의했다. 지난달 전 세계 인공지능 업계를 뒤흔든 수출 통제를 발표한 지 18일 만이다.)

Anthropic announced on X (formerly Twitter) on the 30th (local time) that it had "received notification from the Department of Commerce that export controls on the Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models have been lifted." As a result, the company said it would begin "restoring access to the models" starting on the 1st, after applying additional safety measures to Fable 5 and others. Fable 5 is a publicly available version of the high-performance AI model Mythos, which had raised concerns that hackers could bypass safety measures and exploit it for cyberattacks and other malicious uses. (앤트로픽은 지난 30일(현지시각) 엑스(X·옛 트위터)를 통해 “상무부로부터 클로드 페이블5와 미토스5 모델에 대한 수출 통제를 해제한다는 통보를 받았다”고 밝혔다. 이에 따라 회사는 1일부터 페이블5 등에 추가 안전장치를 적용한 뒤 “모델에 대한 접근권 복원을 시작할 것”이라고 했다. 페이블5는 고성능 인공지능 모델 미토스의 일반 공개 버전으로, 해커가 안전장치를 우회해 사이버 공격 등에 악용할 수 있다는 우려를 받아왔다.)

The letter from the U.S. Department of Commerce included requirements for Anthropic to proactively detect and respond to security risks in its AI models, work with the government to establish safety procedures and operational standards for its models, and notify the government if it discovers malicious uses of the models, such as in cyberattacks. The Commerce Department added that it could reconsider the export restrictions if Anthropic fails to comply with these agreements or if circumstances change. (미 상무부가 전달한 서한에는 앤트로픽이 인공지능 모델의 보안 위험을 사전에 탐지·대응하고, 자사 모델에 적용할 안전 절차와 운영 기준을 정부와 함께 마련하는 한편, 사이버 공격 등 모델의 악의적 활용 사례를 발견하면 정부에 통보해야 한다는 내용 등이 담겼다. 상무부는 앤트로픽이 이런 합의 내용을 이행하거나 상황이 바뀔 경우 수출 제한 조처를 재검토할 수 있다고 덧붙였다.)

U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick stated on X, "Over the past two weeks, we have closely collaborated with Anthropic to analyze and approve Fable 5," adding, "This allowed us to coordinate positions within the government and strengthen America's AI leadership." Anthropic also expressed gratitude, saying, "We thank the users for their patience and everyone who worked to redistribute the models." (하워드 러트닉 미 상무장관은 엑스에 “지난 2주 동안 우리는 앤트로픽과 긴밀히 협력해 페이블5를 분석하고 (공개를) 승인했다”며 “이를 통해 정부 내 입장을 조율하고, 미국의 인공지능 리더십을 강화했다”고 밝혔다. 앤트로픽도 “인내심을 보여준 이용자들과 모델 재배포를 위해 노력한 모든 분께 감사드린다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 12th of last month, the White House imposed export controls on Mythos 5 and Fable 5, citing national security, restricting access not only overseas but also to foreigners within the United States. Later, on the 26th of the same month, it partially eased regulations by allowing access to Mythos 5 for "some trusted partners" approved by the government, while continuing negotiations with Anthropic. Rival company OpenAI has also prioritized its recently released next-generation model, GPT-5.6, for certain customers at the U.S. government's request. (앞서 백악관은 지난달 12일 국가 안보를 이유로 미토스5와 페이블5에 대해 국외는 물론 미국 내 외국인의 접근까지 제한하는 수출 통제를 시행했다. 이후 같은 달 26일 미토스5에 대해선 정부가 승인한 “일부 신뢰할 수 있는 파트너”에 한해 접근을 다시 허용해 규제를 일부 완화한 뒤 앤트로픽과 협상을 이어왔다. 경쟁사인 오픈에이아이(AI)도 최근 공개한 차세대 모델 ‘지피티(GPT)-5.6’을 미 정부 요청에 따라 일부 고객에게만 우선 제공하고 있다.)

Since taking office in January of last year, the Trump administration has maintained a stance of minimizing regulations on AI development while emphasizing the technology rivalry with China. However, last month, it shifted its policy direction by signing an executive order requiring AI companies to voluntarily undergo government pre-review up to 30 days before releasing new models. The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) reported, "The White House is now planning to involve cybersecurity and national security experts more actively in evaluating the safety and potential threats of AI models." While the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)'s Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) under the Department of Commerce has previously pre-assessed the safety of AI models, national security authorities are expected to directly oversee this process in the future. (지난해 1월 출범한 트럼프 행정부는 중국과의 기술 패권 경쟁을 강조하며 인공지능 개발에 대한 규제를 최소화하는 기조를 유지해왔다. 그러나 지난달 인공지능 기업이 새 모델을 공개하기 최대 30일 전 정부의 사전 검토를 자발적으로 받도록 하는 행정명령에 서명하면서 정책 방향을 선회했다. 월스트리트저널(WSJ)은 “백악관은 이제 사이버 보안과 국가안보 전문가들을 인공지능 모델의 안전성과 잠재적 위협을 평가하는 과정에 보다 적극적으로 참여시키겠다는 방침”이라고 전했다. 그동안 미 상무부 산하 국립표준기술연구소(NIST)의 인공지능 표준·혁신센터(CAISI)가 인공지능 모델의 안전성 등을 사전 평가해왔지만, 앞으로는 국가안보 당국이 이 과정을 직접 감독하게 될 전망이다.)

Reporter Seon Dam-eun sun@hani.co.kr (선담은 기자 sun@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Household loans at top 5 banks rise by 4.1 trillion won in June, biggest increase in 11 months (5대 은행 6월 가계대출 4.1조↑…11개월 만 최대폭)
item.description:
Last month, household loan balances at major commercial banks posted their largest increase in 11 months, as credit loans and mortgage loans continued to rise. (지난달 주요 시중은행에서 신용대출과 주택담보대출이 증가세를 지속하면서 가계대출 잔액이 11개월 만에 가장 큰 폭으로 늘었다.)

According to the five major banks (KB Kookmin, Shinhan, Hana, Woori, and NH Nonghyup) on the 1st, household loan balances totaled 774.9608 trillion won at the end of June, up 4.1378 trillion won from 770.8299 trillion won at the end of May. This was the largest increase since July last year (4.1386 trillion won). Following increases of 1.5670 trillion won in April and 3.5269 trillion won in May, the upward trend continued for three consecutive months. <<> Mortgage loan balances stood at 615.1456 trillion won at the end of June, up 1.7576 trillion won from May, marking a third consecutive month of increase. Individual group loans grew by 860.6 billion won, recording the largest increase in one year and nine months since September 2024 (+1.1771 trillion won). <<> Individual credit loan balances (108.6704 trillion won) also rose by 2.1550 trillion won from the previous month, maintaining a growth rate similar to that of the previous month (2.1741 trillion won). <<> In terms of corporate loans, loans to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) by the five major banks totaled 682.7204 trillion won at the end of June, down 1.7368 trillion won from the end of May. SME loans turned to a decline for the first time in six months since December of last year (-2.9018 trillion won). Meanwhile, loans to large corporations increased by 4.9285 trillion won, continuing an upward trend for six consecutive months. <<> Regarding deposit amounts, the balance of savings and time deposits increased for the second consecutive month, but the rate of increase was smaller than the previous month. Time deposit balances reached 949.3998 trillion won, up 4.6837 trillion won from the end of May, while installment savings balances stood at 46.9202 trillion won, up 267.7 billion won. Demand deposit balances, which are funds awaiting investment in stocks and real estate, also rose by 7.6351 trillion won to 722.2928 trillion won. <<> Senior Reporter Jo Gyewan kyewan@hani.co.kr (1일 5대 은행(케이비국민·신한·하나·우리·엔에이치농협)에 따르면, 6월 말 가계대출 잔액은 총 774조9608억원으로 5월 말(770조8299억원)보다 4조1378억원 늘었다. 증가액은 지난해 7월(4조1386억원) 이후 가장 크다. 4월과 5월 각각 1조5670억원, 3조5269억원 증가한 데 이어 석달 연속 증가세를 이어갔다.)

item.title: 30th Anniversary Pokémon Bread a Hit… 10 Million Loaves Sold in 50 Days (30주년 기념 포켓몬빵 대박…50일 만에 1천만봉 팔렸다)
item.description:
Samil’s new “Pokémon Bread” product, launched to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the popular Japanese animation and game series Pokémon, has surpassed cumulative sales of 10 million loaves in just over 50 days since its release. (일본의 인기 애니메이션·게임시리즈 포켓몬스터의 30주년을 기념해 선보인 삼립의 ‘포켓몬빵’ 신제품이 출시 50여일 만에 누적 판매량 1천만봉을 넘어섰다.)

Samil announced on the 1st that the sales volume of this new product is more than seven times the average sales of its new bread products. With the launch of this new product, the inclusion of 30th-anniversary sticker seals in existing Pokémon Bread also boosted average sales of the original products by 1.5 times. (삼립은 이번 신제품 판매량이 자사 신제품 빵 평균 판매량보다 7배를 넘는 수치라고 1일 밝혔다. 이번 신제품 출시와 함께 기존 포켓몬빵에도 30주년 기념 띠부씰을 포함하면서, 기존 제품의 평균 판매량이 1.5배 증가한 것으로 나타났다.)

The sticker storage album “Sticker Seal Book (Venusaur · Charizard),” released alongside the product, also gained immense popularity. Reservations on sales channels such as Kakao, Naver, and Cream sold out within one minute of opening. item.title: Restrictions on Sale of Individual Delinquent Loans Under Fast-Track Debt Adjustment… Protecting Good-Faith Repayers (신속채무조정 중인 개인 연체채권 ‘매각 제한’…성실 상환자 보호)
item.description:
Individual delinquent loans currently undergoing "fast-track debt adjustment" through the Credit Counseling and Recovery Service will be restricted from being sold. Furthermore, when financial companies sell delinquent loans to other institutions such as debt collection and loan-buying firms, they will be required to include terms on resale (restrictions) in the debt sale contract, which is expected to curb repeated resales. (신용회복위원회에서 ‘신속채무조정’ 중인 개인 연체채권은 매각이 제한된다. 또 금융회사가 연체채권을 매입추심대부업체 등 다른 기관에 매각하는 경우 채권매각계약서에 재매각 조건(제약 사항)을 담도록 의무화돼, 반복적인 재매각이 억제될 것으로 기대된다.)

The Financial Services Commission approved a partial amendment to the "Supervisory Regulations on the Management of Individual Financial Claims and the Protection of Individual Financial Debtors" at its regular meeting on the 1st. According to the details, the unilateral sale (assignment) of individual delinquent loans under fast-track debt adjustment by the Credit Counseling and Recovery Service will be restricted. This aims to prevent disadvantages for debtors making good-faith repayments, such as risks of intensified collection efforts or a drop in credit scores due to the sale of their loans. Over the past year, 53,659 individuals applied for fast-track debt adjustment, with 65% of them being debtors without any arrears. (금융위원회는 1일 정례회의에서 ‘개인금융채권의 관리 및 개인금융채무자의 보호에 관한 감독규정’ 일부개정 고시안을 의결했다. 이 내용을 보면, 신복위 신속채무조정 중인 개인 연체채권은 금융사의 일방적 매각(양도)이 제한된다. 성실 상환중인 채무자가 채권매각으로 추심 강화 위험이나 신용평점 하락 등 불이익을 방지하기 위한 것이다. 지난해 1년 동안 신속채무조정 지원자는 5만3659명이며, 이 중에 연체 미발생 채무자 비중은 65%이다.)

The Credit Counseling and Recovery Service's fast-track debt adjustment system supports debtors with arrears of 30 days or less, or those at risk of delinquency before falling behind, by offering installment plans up to 10 years, full exemption of overdue interest, and a reduction of the contractual interest rate by 30-50%. The Financial Services Commission explained that "the fast-track debt adjustment system of the Credit Counseling and Recovery Service serves a preventive function, proactively preventing prolonged delinquency and credit deterioration for those at risk of or in early stages of default," adding that "since the delinquent loans under fast-track debt adjustment involve debtors who have promised and are faithfully repaying, and before long-term arrears occur, selling them midway would impose excessive disadvantages on the debtor." (신복위 신속채무조정 제도는 연체기간이 30일 이하거나 연체 전 연체우려자를 대상으로 최장 10년 분할상환, 연체이자 전액감면, 약정이자율 30∼50% 인하 등을 지원한다. 금융위는 “신복위 신속채무조정 제도는 연체우려 또는 초기에 연체 장기화 및 신용악화를 선제적으로 방지하는 예방적 기능”이라며 “신속채무조정 중인 연체채권은 채무자가 성실한 상환을 약속·이행 중이고 장기연체가 발생하기 전인 만큼 도중 매각은 채무자에 대한 과도한 불이익”이라고 설명했다.)

The amendment also mandates that when selling delinquent loans, the sale contract must include matters related to resale (restriction conditions). This is intended to hold the original creditor financial companies accountable for resale-related issues and curb repeated resales. (개정안은 또 연체채권 매각시 매각계약서에 재매각 관련 사항(제약 조건)을 포함시키도록 의무화했다. 원채권 금융회사에 대해서도 채권 재매각 관련 책임을 부여하고 반복적인 재매각을 억제하기 위한 것이다.)

Practices of unreasonably extending the statute of limitations for delinquent loans to continue collection efforts will also be improved. The amendment stipulates that for financial companies' delinquent loans, only the "completion of the statute of limitations" will be recognized as a loss (write-off) under the Corporate Tax Act. The Financial Services Commission expects this to establish a principle of "completion of the statute of limitations as a rule, with extensions as exceptions." (연체채권의 소멸시효를 무분별하게 연장해 추심을 지속해온 관행도 개선한다. 개정안은 금융회사 연체채권의 경우 ‘시효 완성’에 대해서만 법인세법상 대손(손실)을 인정하기로 했다. 이를 통해 ‘소멸시효의 원칙적 완성, 예외적 연장’ 관행을 정립하게 될 것이라고 금융위는 기대했다.)

Senior Reporter Jo Gye-wan kyewan@hani.co.kr (조계완 선임기자 kyewan@hani.co.kr)
